h1: Window cleaning in Lakeway World of Tennis Condos
intro: The Lakeway World of Tennis Condominiums, built in 1971, are the oldest condo complex in Lakeway. CleanzATX cleans windows for unit owners here, with care for older glass and shared buildings.

sections.h2: What World of Tennis condos are like
paragraphs: The complex dates to 1971 and sits at the World of Tennis center. It has multiple buildings, an HOA and no gate. Units sell for about $250K to $450K. With that age comes older construction and a long history of owners.
Condo living brings rules. The association controls the building exteriors and may have policies for outside contractors. We ask before we come, and we work around the rules you give us.

sections.h2: What World of Tennis windows deal with
paragraphs: Glass that has been up for decades often shows mineral etching, especially on lower floors near sprinklers. Frames may be aluminum, and tracks hold grit that makes windows hard to slide. Cedar pollen from December to February and live oak pollen in March and April settle on balconies and glass doors.

Tennis courts and open lawn areas get irrigated often, and that spray drifts to nearby buildings. Mineral spots that dry in the sun can turn permanent on old glass. Pure water at near 0 TDS rinses cleanly. Spot removal is $10 per pane, and we say honestly if the glass is beyond saving.

sections.h2: How we work World of Tennis
paragraphs: We check with owners about association rules for access, parking and ladders. Because upper floors can be hard to reach, poles help us clean exterior glass from the ground, up to three stories. Inside work is done by hand with drop cloths, and we are careful with older frames and seals. If several neighbors book together, we group visits in the same building.

Unit sizes are not published for the complex, so we quote by window count. At $10 per window, a unit with 12 windows is about $120, and our minimum job of $200 applies. Inside and out at $15 per window is $180 for 12, so the minimum applies there too.

why: Gentle pure water cleaning suits older frames and glass.
Poles reach upper floor windows without ladders against shared walls.
Neighbors in the same building can share a visit.
We tell you honestly when old glass is etched beyond repair.

faq.q: Does the association need to approve you?
faq.a: Check your association rules. We carry $1M insurance and can send proof if the board asks.

faq.q: Can you reach balcony glass on upper floors?
faq.a: Often yes. Poles reach up to three stories from the ground. For balcony doors, we work from the balcony if you allow it.

faq.q: My windows have etched spots. Can you fix them?
faq.a: It depends. Surface mineral deposits can be removed at $10 per pane. Deep etching cannot be undone, and we tell you which you have before we charge.

faq.q: How much for a small unit?
faq.a: Our minimum job is $200. Because units here are smaller, many fall near that number. Neighbors can book together to make the visit worthwhile.

faq.q: Do you clean sliding door tracks?
faq.a: Yes, tracks are $5. Old tracks hold grit that wears the door, so cleaning them helps the door glide.
